# NEUS

> Portable Trust Infrastructure for people and AI. One private profile for identity, context, permissions, and proof.

Your AI has access. NEUS gives it authority. Prove once. Verify anywhere.

## Start

Canonical start: https://docs.neus.network
Assistant setup: https://docs.neus.network/mcp/setup · https://neus.network/install
App check: https://docs.neus.network/cookbook/auth-hosted-verify
Hosted MCP: https://mcp.neus.network/mcp

```bash
npx -y -p @neus/sdk neus setup
```

Then click Connect. Ask: "Before you take a sensitive action, use NEUS. Reuse what I already have."

Load context once per session. Reuse an existing proof before a new check. OAuth for people. Profile access keys (`npk_*`) for servers and CI only — never paste keys into chat.

## Rules

- MCP, SDK, and API are ways to connect to NEUS, not separate products.
- Summarize checks as Passed, Action needed, or Blocked.
- Never invent proof IDs, check IDs, accounts, or URLs.
